g.text: Shading marks E1–8. Dotted TRAIN/TEST lines show a seeded replay. The measured continuation starts at the original E8 checkpoint (dots).
6/6 runs meet the predeclared VAL stability thresholds at E180. All-dataset decision: stop plateau. TEST curves are diagnostic.
